description: The RFC 7517 A.3 set with the empty selector fails with MultipleMatchingKeys; decided by ADR 0054 §1.3: the empty selector matches both oct members, so §4 gives MultipleMatchingKeys; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
